name: Remedolt Giriş Sayfası Özelleştirici
author: remedeolt

sections.description:
Remedolt Giriş Sayfası Özelleştirici (Remedolt Login Page Customizer) lets you replace the default WordPress login screen with your own branded design, entirely from a visual admin panel — no custom code needed.

Features

  • Upload your own logo (with custom width, height, link, and title) to replace the default WordPress logo
  • Choose a solid color, a gradient, an animated “aurora” gradient, a single background image, a full image slideshow, or a looping background video
  • Drag and drop images or videos directly onto the settings page to upload them, or pick them from the media library
  • Reorder slideshow images by dragging them, and optionally play them back in random order
  • Add a color overlay, a slow “breathing” zoom effect, or a mouse-driven parallax effect to the background
  • Fully restyle the login form: background color and opacity, corner radius, shadow, glass blur, input colors, button colors, label and link colors
  • Optional floating particle effect with a choice of shape (circle, star, snowflake) and movement direction
  • A continuous logo animation (float, pulse, or glow)
  • An optional cursor-following spotlight effect on the background
  • An optional 3D tilt effect on the login form that follows the mouse
  • Entrance animations for the login form (fade, zoom, bounce, slide, flip) with adjustable duration, easing, and staggered field animation
  • Button ripple effect, a loading spinner while signing in, and a shake animation on failed login
  • Hide the language switcher, the “back to site” link, the lost password link, or the remember me checkbox
  • An optional announcement/welcome text block between the logo and the form — handy for maintenance notices or a branded greeting
  • An optional dark mode theme that switches automatically based on the visitor’s own OS/browser setting, with its own form, input, button, link, and overlay colors
  • An optional failed-login lockout that blocks further attempts from the same IP address after too many failures
  • A live preview panel on the settings page that updates as you change options, with a one-click dark mode toggle
  • Export and import your settings as a JSON file, or reset everything back to defaults with one click

No external services are contacted, no data is sent anywhere, and no tracking or analytics of any kind is included. All settings are stored in a single WordPress option and removed automatically when the plugin is uninstalled.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/remedolt-login-customizer directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new “Giriş Sayfası” (Login Page) menu item in your admin sidebar to customize your login page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send any data to external servers?

No. Everything runs locally on your own WordPress site using core WordPress APIs (the Settings API, the media library, and your site’s own REST API for uploads). No external requests are made.

Will this work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. The plugin only affects the login page (wp-login.php), which is independent of your active theme.

What happens to my settings if I uninstall the plugin?

All plugin settings are stored in a single option and are automatically deleted when you uninstall the plugin through the WordPress admin.
sections.changelog:
1.5.2

  • Hardened all form-area styling (form background/radius, inputs, buttons, labels, links, announcement, and their dark mode equivalents) with !important, so another active plugin or theme that also styles the login form no longer silently wins the visual conflict

1.5.1

  • Added a font family option (Form Stili tab) — system-font choices only, nothing loaded from an external service
  • Clarified the announcement text field: added a note explaining that the pale example text shown in the empty box is a placeholder, not saved content, and shortened the placeholder itself to reduce confusion

1.5.0

  • Added an optional announcement/welcome text block, shown between the logo and the login form (e.g. for maintenance notices), with its own colors and a light-HTML formatting allowlist (bold, italic, links) — also reflected in the live preview

1.4.0

  • Added an optional failed-login lockout: after a configurable number of failed attempts from the same IP address, further attempts are blocked for a configurable number of minutes
  • Added a ☀️/🌙 toggle to the live preview panel so you can check how your dark mode colors will look without leaving the settings screen
  • The slideshow background now supports a maximum of 24 images per site, to keep very large imports from bloating the settings

1.3.0

  • Added an automatic dark mode option that follows the visitor’s OS/browser preference (prefers-color-scheme: dark), with its own set of form, input, button, link, and overlay colors
  • Uploaded logo, background image, background video, and slideshow images are now verified against the site’s own media library before saving (protects against arbitrary URLs from a manually edited or corrupted import file); if a value can’t be verified, the previous value is kept and an admin notice is shown

1.2.1

  • Removed the free-form custom CSS field, per WordPress.org plugin directory guidelines (no more raw code input)
  • Fixed the Author URI in the plugin header

1.2.0

  • Added a looping background video option, with drag-and-drop or media library upload
  • Added particle shape (circle, star, snowflake) and movement direction options
  • Added a continuous logo animation option (float, pulse, glow)
  • Added an optional cursor-following spotlight effect
  • Added an optional 3D tilt effect on the login form
  • Added three new entrance animation types: slide left, slide right, and flip in

1.1.0

  • Added drag-and-drop image uploads for the logo, background, and slideshow
  • Added an animated gradient background option
  • Added mouse parallax and “breathing” zoom background effects
  • Added staggered field animations, button ripple effect, submit spinner, and error shake animation
  • Added a live preview panel
  • Added settings export/import (JSON) and a one-click reset to defaults

1.0.0

  • Initial release: custom logo, background (color, gradient, image, slideshow), form styling, entrance animations, and element visibility toggles
